publicacoes.legenda:
Casa da Madrinha, in Caminha, at the northern edge of Portugal.

A house with a private pool, a garden and open views over the Minho estuary, for up to eight guests. Long lunches outside, slow afternoons by the water and evenings watching the light fade over the river.

Check dates and ask for a quote through the link in our bio.
